basic_info.headline: Senior / Lead Software Engineer | End-to-End Platform Ownership | Sales, Field Operations, Cloud & Digital Commerce
basic_info.about:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer and hands-on technical leader with 5+ years of experience turning complex business and operational problems into production software.

My work spans the full product lifecycle: requirements discovery, architecture, data modeling, implementation, integrations, cloud infrastructure, deployment, production support, and measurement. I work directly with business and executive leadership to understand what needs to be solved, translate those problems into concrete technical plans, and lead the engineering work required to deliver them.

I've helped build and lead business-critical platforms across sales, field operations, digital commerce, customer acquisition, and recruiting. These systems have supported approximately 1–1.5 million field appointments per year, 1,000–2,000 peak seasonal sales representatives, millions of customer-facing service photos, and approximately $65M in retained annual contract value. I've also partnered on cloud architecture and infrastructure improvements that reduced GCP spend by roughly $30,000 per month.

Alongside hands-on engineering, I've led project planning for other engineers, reviewed architecture and code, mentored and onboarded teammates, and helped turn broad or ambiguous business requirements into maintainable systems. I still enjoy getting deep into the code, but I'm equally interested in figuring out what should be built, how the pieces fit together, and how to help a team execute effectively.

My technical background includes React, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Google Cloud Platform, REST APIs, and cloud/data architecture.

I earned both my Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Computer Science from Bridgewater State University, graduating with a 4.00 GPA in my master's program while serving as a GAANN Fellow.

I'm particularly interested in opportunities where I can combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering—owning meaningful systems, helping other engineers grow, and continuing to build software that has measurable business impact.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
- Lead a team of 4 software engineers responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the company's core software platforms supporting sales, operations, recruiting, customer self-service, and field service.
- Architect and build proprietary web and mobile applications using React, React Native, Node.js, and TypeScript that streamline business processes, improve employee productivity, and enhance the customer experience.
- Drive strategic technology initiatives that supported company growth from approximately $20 million to over $300 million in annual revenue.
- Design, develop, and maintain 5 mission-critical applications that serve as the backbone of day-to-day company operations.
- Architect scalable RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Google Cloud Platform, and BigQuery, enabling secure, high-performance integrations across internal systems and third-party platforms.
- Reduce cloud infrastructure costs by more than $30,000 per month through infrastructure optimization, cloud resource management, database tuning, and performance analysis.
- Lead Agile development processes by facilitating sprint planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, and executive stakeholder reviews to ensure alignment with business objectives.
- Collaborate directly with executive leadership to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and deliver technology solutions that provide measurable business value.
- Integrate enterprise platforms including Okta, PandaDoc, Braintree, Twilio/Five9, and other business-critical services to automate business workflows and improve operational efficiency.
- Lead projects from solution architecture through production deployment while mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and ensuring reliable, scalable, and maintainable software delivery.
